results.name: Rigid world and inverse compose through nonzero yaw and translation
Left/right eye separation survives the world transform
Frustum culling rejects behind-camera chunks but retains crossing chunks
All twelve maps generate finite batched floors, ceilings, walls and export IR
Door meshes use the shared open animation and passage threshold
Atlas materials have unique bounded UV slots with insets
Physical wall leaning cannot enter solid geometry or move the eye through it
Physical motion cannot cross a locked door but can cross an opened door
Head turn and crouch change view without changing body angle or hand aim
Menus freeze movement/fire and discard physical head travel on resume
Tracking discontinuity rebases safely and cancels simulation input
Snap turn triggers once until neutral and smooth turn stays optional
Head-relative and controller-relative movement use different references
Unsafe muzzle extension is clamped at walls and at maximum reach
Floor and ceiling intersections stop vertical tracked shots
Walls occlude tracked targets independently of the gameplay body bearing
All six weapons retain costs/cooldowns and use independent tracked aim
Tracked pulse projectiles hit bodies at height and terminate at the floor
Charged tracked fire uses the existing damage/energy multipliers
The immersive adapter updates once with post-movement muzzle coordinates
Wrist pointer actions suppress primary and alternate fire together
Tracked dodge follows aim without snapping the gameplay body
Old XR callbacks cannot advance a new distinct session after reentry
Version-one saves resume in Classic without persisting XR pose state
Comfort settings sanitize invalid values and preserve snap defaults
Dynamic geometry and effects have bounded buffers and explicit overflow behavior
Immersive session selects the world presenter and advances one shared frame
Missing tracked right hand pauses immersive play without firing
Controller removal and context loss pause or exit without stale input
Failed GL compatibility disposes the partial session and allows retry
Unavailable immersive entry keeps Classic usable and Arcade retry possible
Deferred tracked shooting still drives Michael firing portrait feedback
Canvas wrist HUD ray selection aligns with unlocked weapon buttons
Wrist/map/subtitle canvases stay selective, anchored and actionable
Every owned atlas material paints nonempty art in browser Canvas
Twelve full dynamic world batches stay finite and below capacity

method: Current reconstructed production math, collision, combat, rig and single-clock adapter; synthetic WebXR lifecycle. No physical headset/controller validation. Four actual browser Canvas/atlas/UI/batch checks.
